data.desc: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. ('OTF') is a specialty finance company focused on making debt and equity investments to U.S. technology-related companies, with a strategic focus on software. As of June 30, 2026, OTF had investments in 205 portfolio companies with an aggregate fair value of $14.7 billion. OTF has elected to be regulated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended. OTF is externally managed by Blue Owl Technology Credit Advisors LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser that is an indirect affiliate of Blue Owl Capital Inc. ('Blue Owl') (NYSE: OWL) and part of Blue Owl's Credit platform.
